title: Zalce jailed five days by the Mexican Navy

tellings.quote: I spent around 5 days in jail because they they said I I was a liar and I was putting in risk the honorability of of the whole system of the Navy.

plain: A man named Jose Zalce, who speaks on an episode about small three-fingered bodies found in Peru, says the Mexican Navy jailed him for about five days in the 2020s. He tells it himself, saying they called him a liar who was "putting in risk the honorability of the whole system of the Navy," which would mean he was punished for speaking out.
